title: Headings stay with their text
notes: A supplier writes a feature block as one paragraph - a bold heading, a line break, then the text that belongs to it. The cleaner treated every break as a paragraph break, so the heading was torn off into its own paragraph and left floating above a gap, and the double breaks between blocks disappeared. A single break is now a line break inside the paragraph, keeping a heading and its text in one block; two or more end the paragraph and the extra ones stay as the blank lines they drew.
